title: 第7章 筑基仙族之霸道第8章 李定舟突破灵石三十块
slug: 炼气期如履薄冰元婴期重拳出击
content_zh:
“筑基仙族，柳家的人怎么突然来了？”
族长李光敖下意识看了看李青元，随后望向来人，他的眼中闪过一抹隐忧。
“呼～”他深呼吸后，吩咐道：“你们在此等候，我过去看看。”
咻！
李光敖纵身一掠，御剑飞出百丈后，飘然落地，抱拳一礼道：“李氏族长李光敖，恭迎柳家上使。”
“不知上使来此，有何吩咐？”
仙鹤背上，中年男子毫不掩饰修为，炼气七层灵压弥漫，一脸傲慢。
大长老李光耀吃惊道：“来人竟然是位炼气七层的炼气后期高手？”
李青元问道：“大长老爷爷，此人就是咱们柳鹤岛、唯一的筑基仙族、柳家的修士吗？”
云霞镇，李氏一族的领地，占地方圆三十余里。
而云霞镇，只是柳鹤岛上诸多小镇、城池之一。
柳鹤岛之大，方圆三千余里，纵长横长两条线约七千里，整座岛屿被柳家牢牢掌控。
柳家之下，附庸势力繁多，有三个一流炼气家族、六个二流炼气家族、十二个三流炼气家族。
云霞镇李家，正是十二个三流炼气家族之一。
可以说，筑基仙族·柳家，是柳鹤岛方圆三千余里真正的帝王。
柳鹤岛二十一个炼气家族、各路势力、各个商会、各方散修，都要仰其鼻息，尊其号令。
在柳鹤岛，只要是柳家看上的东西，那么…所有的灵脉、灵药、灵兽、矿场，一切资源，就都是柳家的。
二十一个炼气家族，能在柳鹤岛安家落户，发展壮大，都是因为得到柳家的庇佑。
所以，族长李光敖面对来自柳家的修士，表现得十分恭敬。
对方不仅来自筑基仙族，自身更是炼气七层高手。

柳家使者祭出一块令牌，令牌浮空而立，威压弥漫，令牌上的一个“柳”字代表绝对权威，淡淡道：“传家主令。”
“从今年起，所有炼气家族上供资源，再加一成。”
“啊？”李光敖猛地抬头，难以置信道：“上供资源，再加一成？”
“上使大人，再加一成，这、这让我李氏一族怎么活啊！”
来人阴冷目光一凝，淡淡道：“怎么，你李氏一族要抗命不遵吗？”
“哼，若非我柳家宽厚仁慈，你们李氏一族岂能在云霞镇安家落户数百年？”
“你要记住，没有柳氏庇佑的柳鹤岛，你们这些炼气家族早被妖兽屠戮殆尽。”
阴柔男子淡淡道：“李光敖，做人，要懂得感激。”
李光敖心中大骂：【你们柳氏一族才是柳鹤岛最大的贼吧。】
【哪次妖兽暴动，不是我们十几家炼气家族打头阵，你们柳家坐镇后方，坐享其成。】
content_en:
"Foundation Establishment Immortal Clan, why did the Liu family come suddenly?"
The clan leader Li Guangao looked at Li Qingyuan subconsciously, and then looked at the person coming, a hint of worry flashed in his eyes.
"Huh~" After taking a deep breath, he ordered: "You guys wait here, I'll go over and take a look."
Phew!
Li Guang Ao jumped forward, his sword flew a hundred feet away, then landed on the ground. He cupped his fists and saluted, "Li Guang Ao, the leader of the Li family, welcomes the envoy of the Liu family."
"I wonder what the envoy's orders are when he comes here?"
On the back of the crane, the middle-aged man made no secret of his cultivation, his seventh level of Qi refining spiritual pressure filled the air, and he looked arrogant.
The Great Elder Li Guangyao was surprised: "The person who came here is actually a late-stage Qi Refining master at the seventh level of Qi Refining?"
Li Qingyuan asked: "Grandpa Grandpa, is this person our Liuhe Island, the only Foundation-Building Immortal Clan, and a monk from the Liu family?"
Yunxia Town, the territory of the Li family, covers an area of more than thirty miles.
Yunxia Town is just one of the many small towns and cities on Liuhe Island.
Liuhe Island is huge, with a radius of more than 3,000 miles, and two lines of about 7,000 miles in length and width. The entire island is firmly controlled by the Liu family.
Under the Liu family, there are many vassal forces, including three first-rate Qi refining families, six second-rate Qi refining families, and twelve third-rate Qi refining families.
The Li family in Yunxia Town is one of the twelve third-rate Qi refining families.
It can be said that the Foundation-Building Immortal Clan, the Liu Family, is the true emperor of the more than 3,000-mile radius of Liuhe Island.
The twenty-one qi-refining families, various forces, various chambers of commerce, and various casual cultivators on Liuhe Island must all look up to him and respect his orders.
On Liuhe Island, as long as it is something that the Liu family likes, then...all the spiritual veins, elixirs, spirit beasts, mines, and all resources belong to the Liu family.
The twenty-one Qi Refining families were able to settle down and develop on Liuhe Island because of the blessing of the Liu family.
Therefore, the patriarch Li Guangao behaved very respectfully when facing the monks from the Liu family.
The opponent is not only from the Foundation-Building Immortal Clan, but he is also a seventh-level master of Qi refining.
The Liu family envoy presented a token. The token stood in the air, filled with pressure. The word "Liu" on the token represented absolute authority, and he said calmly: "Heirloom to the family master."
"Starting from this year, all Qi Refining families will provide resources plus an additional 10%."
"Ah?" Li Guangao suddenly raised his head and said in disbelief: "The resources provided, plus 10%?"
"Your Majesty, if you add another 10%, how will the Li family survive?"
The visitor's eyes were cold and cold, and he said calmly: "Why, do you, the Li family, want to disobey orders?"
"Hmph, if it weren't for the generosity and kindness of my Liu family, how could you, the Li family, have settled down in Yunxia Town for hundreds of years?"
"You have to remember that without the protection of Liu He Island, you Qi Refining Family would have been slaughtered by monsters long ago."
The feminine man said calmly: "Li Guangao, as a human being, you must know how to be grateful."
Li Guangao cursed in his heart: "You Liu family are the biggest thieves in Liuhe Island." 】
[In any monster riot, it wasn’t our dozen or so Qi Refining families who took the lead, and you, the Liu family, sat in the rear and enjoyed the results. 】
